set.body:
Purpose

Close the scientific policy and execution gaps exposed once structural design identity is load-bearing.

Phase acceptance criteria

- [ ] Declared factor level sets and empty-cell policies are stable across runs and subjects and are recorded in the design audit.
- [ ] Missing continuous modulators, centering scope, and any supported orthogonalization are selected explicitly and produce receipts.
- [ ] Heterogeneous HRF basis widths can be assigned structurally by cell or phase without manual offsets.
- [ ] Fixed and estimated volume weights are either applied with validated WLS semantics or rejected before execution; no supported configuration remains merely deferred.
- [ ] Rank diagnostics identify numerical rank, pivoting/alias information, condition evidence, residual degrees of freedom, and hypothesis estimability.
- [ ] Shared-across-run, run-specific, and separate-run/fixed-effects coefficient meanings are inspectable model semantics.
- [ ] S06, S08, S09, S13 extension, and S18 pass through public APIs on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Phase 2: make design policies and first-level fit semantics explicit
